_comment: AI-ASSISTED SCAFFOLD from CLARENCE_ZHEN_JIN_TAN_SPECIALISED_WORK_PACKAGE.md sec 4.2 (states), 7.3/7.4 (public prohibitions + evidence card), 9.3 (UX distinctions), 11.1/11.4 (accessibility claim discipline, plain English), 19.3 (prohibited claims). NOT authorship evidence; Clarence must correct wording in his own words and obtain a non-author HCI/content review (C-BLOCK-03). Design goal: APPROPRIATE RELIANCE, not maximum trust or persuasion (WP 7.4).
principle: The interface may simplify but may never strengthen a claim. Missing evidence is never rendered as a negative fact. Uncertainty and abstention are actionable, not hidden.

T.guidance: State the confirmed fact plainly; pair with its grade.

approved: the provider states this is not available
F.guidance: A PUBLISHED contradiction. Must be distinguishable from unknown — do not soften F into 'not stated'.

approved: we don't know from the data
U.guidance: Missing evidence is NOT a negative fact (WP 4.2). Never render U as a definite value or a 'no'.

B.guidance: Show the conflict; never resolve it in the UI by picking a side (WP 4.2).

schedule_derived.guidance: Visibly weaker than explicit; implies no capacity, booking or cancellation status (WP proposal §3 evidence grades).

specification_default.guidance: Weakest; must be flagged as a default, never shown as a provider fact.

supported_match.guidance: State WHAT is supported and by what evidence; never assert suitability beyond the evidence (WP 7.3).

approved: No listed match in what we searched
Nothing in the data we checked matches
bounded_non_match.guidance: 'No observed listed match' is never 'no activity exists' (WP 4.2). Must carry the acquisition-coverage qualifier.

approved: We can't tell from the available data
evidence_indeterminate.guidance: Distinct from bounded_non_match and from service failure (WP 9.3).

scope_complete.guidance: Only when acquisition genuinely complete for the stated scope.

approved: some feeds or areas weren't fully checked
scope_indeterminate.guidance: Never hide a scope limit because one match exists (WP 7.3).

approved: Ordered by fit to your confirmed preferences
authorised_slate.guidance: Ordering reflects confirmed preferences only; expose which ones affected order (WP 7.4).

approved: Automatic ranking was not applied here
model_abstained.guidance: Model abstention is NOT evidence indeterminacy and NOT 'no match' (WP 4.2, 9.3). Offer the deterministic/browse route.

deterministic_fallback.guidance: A designed fallback, not a failure.

approved: Other options that meet your must-haves (not a recommendation)
browse_only.guidance: Label as browse; never present as a model recommendation (WP 4.2).

conditional_terms.accessible: Only as 'accessibility information published' or 'step-free access stated'; never as a blanket 'accessible' claim (WP 11.1).
conditional_terms.free: Only when a structured price/offer is explicitly published as 0; never when price evidence_state is U.
conditional_terms.available: Only for explicitly published availability; never inferred from a schedule.

required_rules.desc: A predicate in state U must not be rendered with any of its banned terms (no/none/free/0/inaccessible/...).
A predicate in state B must render as a conflict, not a resolved value.
No definite listing_attribute claim may be rendered over a predicate whose state is U or B (mirrors INV-NO-COLLAPSE).
bounded_non_match rendering must include an acquisition-coverage qualifier.
model_abstained must not be worded as 'no results'/'no match'.
scope_indeterminate must be surfaced even when a match exists.

accessibility_language.claim: Target 'WCAG 2.2 AA conformance in named tested routes/environments' — never 'fully accessible' or 'accessible to everyone' (WP 11.1).
rules: Plain English; define any technical term at first use.
No colour-only meaning in wording (don't say 'the red ones').
Every evidence state has a text equivalent independent of icon/colour.
Error and recovery messages say what happened and the next safe action.
